mapper.insert:
insert into community ( community_content, created_at, updated_at, community_view_count, community_like_count, community_reply_count, community_deleted, user_no) values ( #{communityContent}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{communityViewCount}, #{communityLikeCount}, #{communityReplyCount}, #{communityDeleted}, 1
)
mapper.select: select * from community where community_no = #{communityNo} and community_deleted = "n"

select c.*, u.user_name, u.user_no, pr.photo_url as profile_photo, group_concat(p.photo_url) as post_photo from community c left join user u on c.user_no = u.user_no left join photo pr on pr.related_entity_id = u.user_no and pr.related_type = 'USER' left join photo p on p.related_entity_id = c.community_no and p.related_type = 'COMMUNITY' where c.community_no = #{communityNo} and c.community_deleted = "n" group by c.community_no, u.user_name, u.user_no, pr.photo_url
mapper.insert: insert into community_reply ( reply_parent_no, reply_content, created_at, reply_deleted, community_no, user_no ) values ( #{replyParentNo}, #{replyContent}, #{createdAt}, #{replyDeleted}, #{communityNo}, #{userNo} )
mapper.select: select r.*, u.user_name, p.photo_url as profile_photo from community_reply r left join user u on r.user_no = u.user_no left join photo p on p.related_entity_id = u.user_no and p.related_type = 'USER' where r.community_no = #{communityNo} and r.reply_deleted = "n" order by r.created_at

select c.*, l.is_liked as isLiked, u.user_name, u.user_no, pr.photo_url as profile_photo, group_concat(p.photo_url) as post_photo from community c left join user u on c.user_no = u.user_no left join photo pr on pr.related_entity_id = u.user_no and pr.related_type = 'USER' left join photo p on p.related_entity_id = c.community_no and p.related_type = 'COMMUNITY' left join community_like l on l.community_no = c.community_no and l.user_no = #{userNo} where c.community_deleted = "n" group by c.community_no, u.user_name, u.user_no, pr.photo_url, l.is_liked order by c.created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into community_like ( created_at, is_liked, user_no, community_no ) values ( #{createdAt}, #{isLiked}, #{userNo}, #{communityNo} )
